scope: M5-05 hostile-input and resource-boundary regression matrix for the local core scanner and CLI; not an independent security certification, formal accuracy measurement, target-runtime result, Issue #7 acceptance or release authorization.
commands: pnpm exec prettier --write packages/core/src/index.ts apps/cli/src/index.ts tests/security-matrix.test.ts

fullCheck.authority: Local evidence only; PR and main GitHub Actions runs are authoritative.

threatMatrix.test: normalizes absolute and dot-dot project roots while keeping report paths relative
threatMatrix.expected: Equivalent roots produce the same canonical report and the absolute root is not disclosed.

threatMatrix.test: treats an explicitly selected root symlink as the scan root and keeps internal links skipped
threatMatrix.expected: The selected root is followed once; internal symlinks are skipped and disclosed.

threatMatrix.test: skips a Unix socket as a special file without opening it
threatMatrix.expected: The socket is not opened and special-file-skipped is disclosed.

threatMatrix.test: fails closed when the scan entry budget is exceeded
threatMatrix.expected: More than 10000 visited entries aborts the scan.

threatMatrix.test: fails closed when the cooperative scan deadline is already exhausted
threatMatrix.expected: A zero-millisecond core deadline throws a stable ScanDeadlineError diagnostic.

threatMatrix.test: fails closed through the CLI when its scan deadline is zero
threatMatrix.expected: CLI exits 1, stdout is empty and stderr contains only Scan time limit exceeded (0 ms).

threatMatrix.test: fails closed at the per-file, aggregate and directory-depth limits
threatMatrix.expected: Files above 1 MiB, aggregate input above 32 MiB and depth beyond 64 fail closed.

threatMatrix.test: fails closed on an overlong workspace selection without echoing it
threatMatrix.expected: An overlong workspace pattern is marked unsafe and omitted from the report.

threatMatrix.test: keeps hostile Markdown fields inert while retaining their machine-readable values
threatMatrix.expected: Markdown neutralizes HTML, control characters and active link syntax; SARIF retains canonical values.

threatMatrix.test: does not execute lifecycle scripts while preserving inventory unknowns
threatMatrix.expected: Lifecycle scripts are never run and inventory remains explicit unknown.

threatMatrix.test: sanitizes filesystem failures at the CLI boundary
threatMatrix.expected: CLI exits 1 and exposes only a stable filesystem code without private paths.

threatMatrix.test: rejects corrupt manifests through a stable CLI diagnostic without echoing source
threatMatrix.expected: CLI exits 1 with a stable diagnostic and does not echo source or a placeholder secret.

threatMatrix.test: redacts credential-bearing URLs from canonical and rendered reports
threatMatrix.expected: User info, password and token values are absent from JSON, Markdown and SARIF.

residualRisks.description: The cooperative timeout checks between asynchronous boundaries and cannot interrupt a synchronous parser that has already started.
residualRisks.disposition: documented limitation; independent security review required

residualRisks.description: CPU and peak-memory budgets have not been measured independently on frozen small, medium and large inputs.
residualRisks.disposition: blocked on frozen performance inputs and independent review

residualRisks.description: A privileged actor can replace directories during traversal; this local model does not defend against all time-of-check/time-of-use races.
Operating-system-specific special files, real malicious supply-chain inputs and independent security certification remain untested.
residualRisks.disposition: independent review required before formal acceptance

acceptanceBoundary: Issue #7 remains open. Independent security review, formal metrics, actual-runtime validation, performance budgets, legal disposition and final adjudication remain required.
